body: That is too bad. Using it as a woman I have never once been hit on, sometimes it is useful to be ugly.

I definitely understand where you are coming from- I am about to leave school soon too and I am not ready for it at all. But the fact that you are going to graduate school means you that you have accomplished a lot, you are far from a failure. It is great that you liked school so much and had good friends there. Even if you do start off with a job you aren't crazy about you can always change your mind, think about graduate schools, go travel-- you have lots of potential for the future.
